en.title: Two Latvian men arrested on suspicion of trespass at RAF base in Cambridgeshire
en.summary: Police detained two Latvian men around 2:00 AM after discovering them inside the perimeter of a Royal Air Force base in Cambridgeshire.

stories.title: Two Latvian men arrested at RAF base in Cambridgeshire used by US military

en.title: Two Latvian men arrested at RAF base in Cambridgeshire used by US military
en.summary: Two men aged 32 and 36 were arrested at RAF Molesworth in the early hours after being found inside the base perimeter; they face suspicion of trespass, criminal damage, and entering a prohibited place.

en.title: Warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful, court says
en.summary: A court ruled that warrants authorizing searches of the former prince's residences were unlawful, though a criminal investigation remains ongoing and seized material is retained.

en.title: Two Latvian men arrested on suspicion of trespass offences at RAF base
en.summary: Two men aged 36 and 32 were arrested following an apparent break-in at RAF Molesworth on 7 October.

stories.title: At least 30 killed as Russian guided bomb hits civilian bus in Ukraine

en.title: At least 30 killed as Russian guided bomb hits civilian bus in Ukraine
en.summary: A Russian guided bomb struck a civilian bus in Ukraine, killing at least 30 people. The attack followed recent missile strikes on the northern town of Pryluky.

en.title: Police raids on Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's royal properties were unlawful
en.summary: A court determined that police raids on the former Duke's properties were unlawful. He had been arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office earlier this year.

stories.title: Russian bomb destroys public bus in Ukraine killing at least 30 people

en.title: Russian bomb destroys public bus in Ukraine killing at least 30 people
en.summary: A Russian bomb destroyed a public bus in Ukraine, resulting in at least 30 deaths.

stories.title: Search warrants used in Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor raids were unlawful, court rules

en.title: Search warrants used in Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor raids were unlawful, court rules
en.summary: A judge ruled that search warrants used in police raids on Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor were unlawful following his judicial review. The warrants had been granted in connection with a Jeffrey Epstein investigation.

en.summary: Two men from Latvia have been arrested on suspicion of trespassing at a Royal Air Force base in Cambridgeshire.

stories.title: Russian attack on bus kills at least 30 people near Ukraine frontline

en.title: Russian attack on bus kills at least 30 people near Ukraine frontline
en.summary: A Russian aerial strike hit a bus in Kramatorsk, an eastern Ukrainian city, killing at least 30 people and wounding 18 others in one of the deadliest civilian attacks this year.

stories.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge

en.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
en.summary: Russia struck buses in the frontline city of Kramatorsk with the apparent intent to kill civilians, resulting in significant casualties among the population.

stories.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor and Thames Valley Police agreed warrants to raid two properties were unlawful

en.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor and Thames Valley Police agreed warrants to raid two properties were unlawful
en.summary: A High Court judge determined that search warrants used by Thames Valley Police to raid two properties belonging to Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor earlier this year were unlawful, with both parties agreeing to this finding.

stories.title: Oil prices jump on tanker attacks and slowing flows through Strait of Hormuz

en.title: Oil prices jump on tanker attacks and slowing flows through Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Oil prices rose following tanker attacks and reduced shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Transit through the waterway had recovered to near 90% of prewar levels but subsequently declined sharply.

stories.title: Scores of Riyadh flights cancelled after Houthis target airport

en.title: Scores of Riyadh flights cancelled after Houthis target airport
en.summary: Multiple flights from Riyadh were cancelled after Houthi attacks on the airport. A Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting missiles as loud explosions were heard over the capital.

stories.title: Daughter of Trump’s chief of staff works at firm that lobbies for Republika Srpska

en.title: Daughter of Trump's chief of staff works at firm that lobbies for Republika Srpska
en.summary: The daughter of Trump's chief of staff is employed at a firm conducting lobbying activities for Republika Srpska. This represents another instance of a White House-linked adviser having connections to the Russian-aligned Balkan entity.

stories.title: French bond sell-off prompts ‘bottom fishing’ across Europe

en.title: French bond sell-off prompts 'bottom fishing' across Europe
en.summary: Asset managers are purchasing French bonds following recent sell-offs, with some dismissing concerns that the situation resembles the earlier Eurozone debt crisis.

stories.title: Goldman to pay top executives $500mn in special bonuses

en.title: Goldman to pay top executives $500mn in special bonuses
en.summary: Goldman Sachs is distributing $500 million in special equity bonuses to senior executives. The awards are drawn from a five-year compensation scheme for top leadership.
